latest_news_en: Unveiling second-generation software at TechCrunch Disrupt October 2026, selected for 2026 Startup Battlefield 200, early customers already using version 2 with public availability this week
source_title: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes

evidence.quote: Customers can start with a description or sketch of a project and create blueprints for every aspect of a building at once, including architecture, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and interior design. Version 2 allows users to design and make changes to the project, an upgrade over the first iteration. Importantly, one design change updates the entire project and is checked against local building codes.

Dram earned his bachelor's and master's degrees in architecture from the University of Tehran and completed two years of PhD coursework on digital design at the European Graduate School in Switzerland. He moved to the United States and opened an architecture firm in 2018 called Drams Design-Build. Then, after obtaining a general contractor's license, he added a construction business in 2021.

evidence.quote: A supervision screen, as Caposino defines it, has four parts: a live summary of what the AI is doing, the evidence behind each action it proposes, a queue of actions waiting for a person's approval, and controls to pause the system and roll back what is reversible

Its Omnik-BIOS AI Agent focuses on biologics and protein therapeutics R&D analysis, while Omnik-QD AI Agent assists quality and regulatory teams with document review. Platform supports private cloud and on-premises deployment and integrates with existing quality management, laboratory information and manufacturing execution systems
latest_news: 2026年10月在日本横滨BioJapan 2026展会上展示其生物制药AI操作层平台,成立于2018年总部位于台北,4月与日本AI科学计算初创公司Chiral签署首个日本合作伙伴关系,5月与数字制造解决方案提供商LSDC Co., Ltd签署谅解备忘录
latest_news_en: Showcased Biopharma AI Operating Layer platform at BioJapan 2026 in Yokohama, Japan in October 2026. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Taipei. Signed first Japanese partnership with AI scientific computing startup Chiral in April and MOU with digital manufacturing solutions provider LSDC Co., Ltd. in May
source_title: TherapiAI Showcases Agentic AI Platform for Biopharma at BioJapan 2026 - The Manila Times

evidence.quote: Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, TherapiAI develops a private AI agent platform for biopharmaceutical companies and CDMOs.

The Biopharma AI Operating Layer combines two specialized agents with a platform for managing AI across the enterprise. The Omnik-BIOS AI Agent focuses on R&D for biologics and protein therapeutics. It supports analysis of protein sequences, three-dimensional structures, post-translational modifications (PTMs), immunogenicity and developability, helping teams identify potential risks early in development.
